about: The decision table for who may sign a paper (a roster, a presigned invite, an Ask me first invite) that raises someone to a role: making no one more than a viewer, any device that approves; an editor, a browser all the way back to its root (browser_chained) or the desktop app's device (from_app: an app certificate, or a browser one the app named); an owner, only such a browser. Never a CLI's key, which an agent on its machine can read. browser_chained is Trust::browser_chained for the signer (cert/browser_chained); this table takes it as given.
